title: Beef Cabbage & Carrot Stir Fry (Thịt Bò Xào Bắp Cải Cà Rốt) - Vicky Pham
ldName: Beef Cabbage & Carrot Stir Fry (Thịt Bò Xào Bắp Cải Cà Rốt)
ldKeywords: beef and cabbage stir fry, easy beef stir fry, quick cabbage stir fry, asian beef cabbage recipe, beef stir fry with vegetables, chinese beef and cabbage, stir fry with beef and cabbage, easy asian stir fry, simple beef and cabbage dish, homecooked stir fry, how to make beef stir fry, thit bo xao, how to make thit bo xao, cabbage recipe, carrot recipe, easy stir fry asian recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 10 oz beef (cut into thin slices against the grain)
2 green onions (thinly sliced with greens and whites separated)
4 oz carrot (about 1 large, peeled, cut on a bias into slices)
1 lb sliced cabbage (cut into small squares)
ldInstructionsRaw: In a bowl, mix sliced beef (10 oz) with baking soda (⅛ tsp), sugar (¼ tsp), salt (½ tsp), water (¼ cup), egg white (1), and cornstarch (3 tbsps).
In a small bowl, stir together water (⅓ cup), light soy sauce (2 tbsps), dark soy sauce (2 tbsps), sugar (1 tsp), and cornstarch (2 tbsps) until starch is dissolved. Set aside.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat with oil (3 tbsps). Add the marinated beef in a single layer and pan fry until it’s about 50% done — just starting to brown but still pink in spots.
Add garlic (1 tbsp), whites of green onions (from 2 stalks), and sliced carrot (4 oz). Stir-fry for about 2 minutes to let the carrot soften slightly.
Stir in the cabbage (1 lb) and pour in the stir fry sauce. Toss everything together for another 2–3 minutes until the cabbage wilts and the sauce thickens.
Turn off the heat, garnish with the remaining green parts of the green onions, and serve with rice or noodles for a complete meal.
